Set up a downstream package to use rvtk

Source: R/use_rvtk.R
use_rvtk.Rd

A usethis-style helper that configures a downstream R package to link against VTK via rvtk. It performs the following steps:

  • Adds rvtk to the Imports field of DESCRIPTION.

  • Writes src/Makevars that queries compiler and linker flags at install time by calling tools/configure.R.

  • Writes src/Makevars.win with the Windows-specific $(shell ...) syntax that does the same.

  • Writes tools/configure.R that calls CppFlags() and LdFlagsFile() with the requested VTK modules.

  • Adds src/vtk_libs.rsp to .gitignore (it is generated at install time and must not be committed).

  • Creates R/rvtk_imports.R with a minimal @importFrom rvtk roxygen tag so that R CMD check does not complain about rvtk being listed in Imports without any function import in the R code.

After running use_rvtk() the downstream package is fully configured: VTK compiler and linker flags are resolved automatically at R CMD INSTALL time on all platforms without any shell configure / configure.win scripts.

Usage

use_rvtk(
  modules = c("vtkIOLegacy", "vtkIOXML", "vtkIOXMLParser", "vtkIOCore", "vtkIOGeometry",
    "vtkFiltersCore", "vtkFiltersGeneral", "vtkFiltersGeometry", "vtkFiltersModeling",
    "vtkFiltersExtraction", "vtkCommonCore", "vtkCommonDataModel",
    "vtkCommonExecutionModel", "vtkCommonMath", "vtkCommonMisc", "vtkCommonSystem",
    "vtkCommonTransforms", "vtksys"),
  path = "."
)

Arguments

modules

A character vector of VTK module names to link against. These are passed to LdFlagsFile() in the generated tools/configure.R, restricting linking to only the modules the downstream package needs. Defaults to a standard set covering the common I/O, filtering, core, and data-model modules bundled with rvtk.

path

Path to the root of the downstream package. Defaults to the current working directory.

Value

Invisibly, the normalised path to the package root. Called primarily for its side effects.

See also

CppFlags(), LdFlagsFile()

Examples

# Configure a minimal package in a temporary directory
pkg <- file.path(tempdir(), "mypkg")
dir.create(pkg, recursive = TRUE)
writeLines(c(
  "Package: mypkg",
  "Title: My Package",
  "Description: A package that links against VTK.",
  "Version: 0.0.1"
), file.path(pkg, "DESCRIPTION"))
use_rvtk(path = pkg)
#> ✔ Added rvtk to Imports in DESCRIPTION.
#> ✔ Writing src/Makevars.
#> ✔ Writing src/Makevars.win.
#> ✔ Writing tools/configure.R.
#> ✔ Adding "src/vtk_libs.rsp" to .gitignore.
#> ✔ Writing R/rvtk_imports.R.
#> ✔ Package mypkg is now configured to link against VTK via rvtk.
list.files(pkg, recursive = TRUE)
#> [1] "DESCRIPTION"       "R/rvtk_imports.R"  "src/Makevars"     
#> [4] "src/Makevars.win"  "tools/configure.R"
unlink(pkg, recursive = TRUE)
